sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ben Bulben is an Irish mythological site. The peak rises on the coast above the town of Sligo. A mound of stone sits near its summit. The hero Diarmait Ua Duibne died beside it. A magical boar had carried the hero on its back. Diarmait killed the beast. He then brushed against its body and pierced himself on a poisonous bristle. Fionn Mac Cumhaill was a healer and could have saved him. He chose to taunt the dying man instead. Grainne, Fionn's intended wife, had loved the younger Diarmait for years. That love drained Fionn as he chased the pair across Ireland. The peak now shadows the grave of William Butler Yeats.

okr.objective: Ben Bulben is the Sligo peak where the hero Diarmait Ua Duibne died, now tied to the poet Yeats.
